aaa_enabled.summary: Configure remote administrative authentication (TACACS+, RADIUS, or LDAP) on F5 BIG-IP.
aaa_enabled.notes: Define your remote authentication servers first and ensure fallback to local is enabled to prevent lockout.

secure_vty_transport.summary: Enforce SSH administration and disable Telnet (default on BIG-IP).
secure_vty_transport.notes: F5 BIG-IP does not run an onboard Telnet daemon. Ensure SSH is enabled.

vty_idle_timeout.notes: Set SSH and HTTPS Configuration Utility idle timeouts in seconds (e.g. 900 and 1200 seconds).

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Ensure administrative account passwords are encrypted.
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: BIG-IP TMOS automatically hashes/encrypts all user administrative passwords at rest.

cli: tmsh modify /sys snmp communities delete { public }
no_default_snmp_community.notes: Remove the standard public community string to prevent unauthorized information disclosure.

http_server_disabled.summary: Insecure HTTP management is disabled by default on BIG-IP.
http_server_disabled.notes: The Apache httpd daemon defaults to HTTPS-only access on port 443 or 8443.

ssh_version_2.notes: The TMOS SSH server natively enforces SSHv2 by default.

cli: tmsh modify /sys syslog remote-servers add { log-server-1 { host 192.168.1.100 remote-port 514 } }
logging_enabled.notes: Add your central remote syslog server IP and port.

management_acl.summary: Restrict management plane access to allowed IP networks.
management_acl.notes: Replace the allow-all default with your dedicated administrator subnet ranges.

cli: tmsh modify /sys sshd banner enabled banner-text "Authorized Access Only."
tmsh modify /sys global-settings gui-security-banner-text "Authorized Access Only."
login_banner.notes: Enforce pre-login warning messages for both SSH console and HTTPS Configuration Utility.

password_min_length.summary: Configure local administrative password policy restrictions.
cli: tmsh modify /auth password-policy policy-enforcement enabled minimum-length 12
password_min_length.notes: Enable policy-enforcement and set minimum length to 12 characters or longer.

ntp_configured.notes: Define upstream time servers to synchronize system logs and events.

no_write_snmp_community.summary: Ensure SNMP communities are restricted to read-only access (default on TMOS).
no_write_snmp_community.notes: Standard BIG-IP SNMP community configurations grant read-only access only.
